title: fix(plugin-list): the sort picker leaves out a field the object marks hidden, as the filter list does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg7b913SptrRMtzTBi127R7U)_

domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb5R6JDdfyvtj3dPR2

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 列表的「排序」选择器不再列出对象定义里标了 `hidden: true` 的字段（队列、未翻译的 Search Index、组织等系统列），与「筛选」面板的字段列表同一条规则；视图或已存排序本来就按这类字段排的，那一行照旧显示，标为不可选、可删除。
- **为什么改：** 销售添加排序时会看到「队列」和英文的 "Search Index"，对他们毫无意义，按搜索索引排序得到的顺序也无从解释；筛选面板早已把这些字段藏起，只有排序漏了。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改 Console 前端的排序字段列表，不改存储形状、不加元数据键；服务端排序能力不变。已按隐藏字段排序的视图照常加载和排序。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看：** `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`（新的 `isDeclaredHidden` 与 `sortFields` 循环开头的 `offered` 判定）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.sortRemovableOnly-11943.test.tsx`，预期 6 个用例全绿，其中 `hidden:` 一条钉住隐藏字段只在当前排序点名时以不可选形式出现。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

Fixes #30037

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, one rule shared by three field lists:

- **`isDeclaredHidden(defs, field)`**, a module-level predicate beside `canReadField`: the object definition marks the field `hidden: true`. The Filter panel's list (`filterFields`) and the hide-fields lists' addable fields (`addableFields`) already asked this question inline; both now call the predicate, unchanged in behaviour.
- **The Sort picker (`sortFields`) asks it too.** A field is offered only when the user may read it and the definition does not mark it hidden. A hidden field the current sort already names is kept by the existing in-use exception, listed removable only (`disabled`), exactly as an unreadable field is: its row shows its label and can be removed, no other row and no "Add sort" can choose it. A hidden lookup (the platform's `organization_id`) no longer raises the relational hint under the rows, since the picker never offered it; a visible lookup still does.
- The memo's dependency list gains `objectDef`, which the loop now reads.

What is persisted and requested is unchanged: a hidden field is sortable on the server, so a stored sort naming one keeps being sent and saved (the #6455 persist boundary filters platform-refused entries only).

## Acceptance

The card's list, verbatim, each item pinned:

> 1. The sort picker leaves out a field declared `hidden`, unless the current sort already names it. That row stays visible and removable, as today's `inUse` path does for other fields.

Pinned by `ListView.sortRemovableOnly-11943.test.tsx`: `FIELD_DEFS` gains a hidden `search_index` ("Search Index", standing in for `__search` and `queue`), so every case's exact option list now asserts it is absent; the new `hidden:` case declares it first and sorts by it, and asserts it is listed disabled, its row shows it, "Add sort" skips it, the new row offers it only as unavailable, and removing its row drops it from the list.

> 2. The hide-fields, group and row-color lists are read for the same gap, and any that share it are fixed here, with the list of what was read in the PR.

Read on this head, no gap found, nothing changed in them:

- **Hide-fields popover and View settings section, column list:** `allFields`, built from the view's declared `columns` only. A hidden field appears there only when the view's author declares it as a column, and then the grid draws it (`effectiveFields` drops unreadable and user-hidden columns, not definition-hidden ones), so listing it is consistent with the grid.
- **Hide-fields lists, fields a reader may add:** `addableFields` already leaves out a definition-hidden field; it now asks the shared predicate.
- **Group editor** (`GroupingEditor fieldOptions`) and **Row color select**: both read `allFields`, the same declared-columns list as above.

> 3. A test pins the sort picker.

Item 1's pins, plus `ListView.sortFieldRead-11943.test.tsx` (new top-level `describe`): a hidden lookup is not offered and raises no relational hint, while the same lookup unhidden raises it.

## Acceptance notes

The card's "To check while here" names two Studio lists. Both live in `ui/packages/app-shell/**`, outside this order's file surface, so they were read, not measured in a running Studio and not changed:

- **Formula 插入字段** (`ObjectFieldInspector`, the `fieldOptions` it hands `CelPredicateField`): every entry of the object draft's field list except the field itself, with no hidden check. Whether the draft carries the injected `queue` / `__search` columns was not measured here. A formula may legitimately read some hidden columns (`queue`, `owner`), so this is an implementer's judgement, not a mechanical copy of this rule.
- **Validation 参与字段** (`ObjectValidationsPanel`, the `cross_field` checkbox list): every field of the list it is handed. The panel already reads `hidden` (its new-rule default skips hidden fields) but the checkbox list does not filter on it.

## Tests

Red first, on `origin/main` code with the new pins (`ListView.tsx` restored to its base, commit `91cec45d`): Test Files 2 failed (2), Tests 6 failed, 6 passed (12). Each failure reads "Search Index" listed (the exact option lists) or the relational hint drawn for the hidden lookup.
